lanes.title: run record keeps research; closing the game keeps the run workbook (D-086)
lanes.brief: SCOPE (D-086, READING DE-R (a)): this lane may change Sim.Ui (the exit path in SimUiGame.OnExiting and GameUi.SaveOnExit, the session export under Sim.Ui/Export with its codebook and README text) and Sim.Core/Observability (the observation and telemetry records that carry the research rows, their writer and readers, the forensic reader if the telemetry tag moves), and read-only Sim.Core/State queries if a research reading needs one, with their tests (Sim.Tests, Sim.Ui.Tests); nothing in Sim.Core/Kernel; no simulation state, world hash or campaign golden change (the research rows observe state that already exists); no permanent project; no CI change; no merge, tag or release. Read docs/d086-run-record-research-and-exit-export-2026-11-11.md first (DE1-DE3 and the readings), then ADR-059 and D-066 A14-A17, D-068, D-071 (one Excel file; the hidden runs\.record folder), docs/m6-session-export/README.md, docs/validation-policy.md, and the code: Sim.Ui/SimUiGame.cs OnExiting, Sim.Ui/GameUi.cs SaveOnExit, Sim.Ui/UiSession.cs (Save, FinalizeTelemetry, ExportForensicClose, ExportWorkbook), Sim.Ui/Export/*, Sim.Core/Observability (Observer, TelemetryWriter, the forensic readers). (1) RESEARCH IN THE RUN RECORD (DE1; readings DE1-R1..R3 (a)): every polity's research, every turn: for each node that received points, the node, the lane (Technology or Civics), the points received that turn, the accumulated progress and the node's cost, the Civics bank drawn where it applies, and a completion row (the turn the node completed). Choose where the rows travel (the telemetry line with a new tag, telemetry/v6 per the T4.20 rule, or a record file of its own listed by the forensic close record) and justify it; add a Research sheet (or columns) to the session workbook, coded like the other sheets with every code in the Codebook (the workbook stays CODED, NEVER TRUNCATED, DETERMINISTIC and self-checked); keep older sessions exportable (a v5 session exports with the research sheet marked not recorded, never invented). Tests: the rows for a known short headless session equal the state's research progress turn by turn (exact integers or the record's own number format), AI polities included; a completion row on the turn the node completes (turn-exact); the workbook round trip and self-check with the new sheet; a populated round trip for any new serialized row; older-vintage sessions still export. (2) THE CLOSE (DE2; DE2-R1 (a)). The Director's own failing session (20261108-155547-a1, build 7d5defc, win-x64, 850 turns, years 0-5100, 25.2M people at the end) had a telemetry log of 168 MB (the Director's figure; it could not be uploaded); the four small record files the Director sent are kept at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-civDemo/54b82655-610f-500e-a185-8fae64bdd108/scratchpad/m7gov/user-session-20261108/record/ (no forensic file was sent), and the orchestrator rebuilt their workbook from them in 0.5 s without telemetry. Size the measurement to that: a session whose telemetry reaches the hundreds of MB, measuring time AND peak memory of every close step and of the export. If a workbook that holds every telemetry line cannot be built in reasonable time and memory at that size, say so with the numbers and present the alternatives as a PROPOSAL for the Director (for example the raw log kept compressed beside the workbook, or the Telemetry sheet split or summarized), because ADR-059's amendment made the Telemetry sheet the log's only copy. (a) reproduce and measure: build a long headless session (for example sim run --founded --seed 42 --turns N --ai-empires 1 --emit-session for N up to the longest that fits the time budget) and measure each step of the close (save, telemetry finalize, forensic close, export, removal) and the export alone with --export-session, so the cost of a long game is known; (b) keep the window responsive and showing that the run is being saved while the close work runs (for example the work on a worker thread with the game loop drawing a saving screen, the exit completing when it is done), with no change to what is written; (c) make an interrupted close recoverable: the six record files are complete (or the export says plainly which one is not) before the workbook step starts, and a second close request during the work does not corrupt anything; (d) reduce the export's time where it can be done without dropping its self-check, measured before and after. Tests for each: the saving state shown, the order of the steps unchanged, recovery by --export-session after an interrupted close (a test seam), timings recorded in the report. (3) A PLAIN RECOVERY NOTE for the Director in docs/m6-session-export/README.md (what to do when no workbook appears: the command from the game folder, start /wait "" "app\Sim.Ui.exe" --export-session runs, or sending the hidden runs\.record folder). (4) VALIDATION per docs/validation-policy.md with scripts/validate.sh: targeted after edits, integration when coherent, full (Tier 3) because Sim.Core/Observability changes; one full suite at a time; the smoke (--smoke) if the exit path changes; report what ran, what was selected but NOT RUN and why, and what was deferred. Every moved golden or pin gets a measured attribution. (5) REPORT docs/m6-plan/run-record-research-and-exit-2026-11.md: what changed (files, line counts), the measured close timings before and after, tests, mutants (bounded, each killed by a semantic test), what ran, NOT RUN, deferred, and questions for the Director only where genuinely open.
